text:
Nadia Park: @here New GA: Hosted Sprinter (hosted-sprinter.v1) is live across our major regions — optimized for sub-50ms tail latency on short-turn interactive workloads. :sparkles:

Nadia Park: High level: new endpoint https://api.redwood.com/v1/hosted-sprinter, tiled streaming with adaptive chunk sizes, and a tuned batching profile that prioritizes latency over throughput. Quantization defaults balance cost and fidelity for small-context chats. Beta (hosted-sprinter-beta) will be retired in 45 days.

Nadia Park: Migration curl example:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/hosted-sprinter/generate \\
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \\
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\
  -d '{"model":"sprinter-lite","input":"Give me three bullet points","stream":true,"max_tokens":120}' \\
  --no-buffer
```

ReleaseBot: release-bot: hosted-sprinter.v1 deployment succeeded (us-east-1: 150 nodes, eu-west-2: 70 nodes, ap-northeast-1: 50 nodes). Canary passed latency SLA. :white_check_mark:

Owen Li: Congrats team! Quick question: does sprinter change tool-calling shape or is it identical to hosted-standard?

Nadia Park: Owen Li tool-calling is supported; we added an optional `multiplex_tools` flag that enables concurrent tool expansion for tiled responses. Default preserves existing schema. SDK shims will handle compatibility, but if you explicitly use multiplexing, update SDK to v0.12+.

Maya Thompson: Where can support find the new observability panels? Need to add to runbook.

Nadia Park: Maya Thompson panels are in Console -> Models -> hosted-sprinter.v1 -> Observability. We've added per-request tail-latency percentiles, cost-per-token breakdown by quant profile, and a streaming chunk histogram. I'll pin the doc in #product-docs.

eng-sre: eng-sre: Free/trial org limits remain unchanged but default concurrency for streaming is 1 for trials. Paid orgs inherit their configured concurrency. If a customer needs a demo uplift, open a ticket with "sprinter-demo" tag.

Owen Li: Planning to update partner SDK samples. Any recommended messaging on cost vs hosted-standard?

Nadia Park: Recommend: Sprinter is lower-latency and slightly higher per-token due to low-latency kernel selection; for bursty chat use it, for long-context generation prefer hosted-standard with caching. We'll publish a one-pager and a small cost/latency chart in the docs.

Maya Thompson: Can we schedule a 30m walkthrough for support + partners tomorrow 11:00 PT?

Nadia Park: Scheduled 11:00 PT, invite to the "sprinter-migration" channel sent. We'll cover migration checklist, SDK snippets, and throttling guidance.

Owen Li: Awesome 44d Thanks all 389

Nadia Park: Huge thanks to runtime, infra, and devex for landing this. If you see anomalies, post to #incidents and tag @eng-oncall.

Nadia Park: Quick note: we'll enable a 30-day compatibility flag for the beta path to ease migration for integrations that can't update immediately.
